audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits 52.29% over 503 games; chart all-Pantheon is consistent across full, content and packet — Ziggs never gets a stage because his only defence is one Satchel Charge and he has zero dashes.

audit.corrected: spikes[3] created with before:null covering his late artillery phase, grounded in kit (R 5000 range at 70s max rank, W 12s escape).

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] says 'Kite with W minefield' — the minefield is his E (Hexplosive Minefield, 16s); Satchel Charge is W. breakdown.cooldowns has no digits and no sequencing.
audit.why: Kit: Q Bouncing Bomb 6-4s 850-range projectile (your Aegis front-blocks it), W Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12s self-knockback escape, E minefield 16s slow, R Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s 5000-range projectile. His P Short Fuse is an auto-reset — the wind-up is the step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Slot fixed; numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad bleeds.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Aegis Assault has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge (W): 20s at rank 1, 12s max — his only escape; he is catchable the whole time it is down. - His Q spam runs 6s, mines 16s. - Your E Aegis Assault has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it goes right.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: At level 2 his only out is a 20-second Satchel Charge — W-stun the immobile mage and cash empowered Q free.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: His Q bounces reach 850 and mines cover the gap — at his range you eat poke for nothing; approach behind minions or leave.

Late, his Mega Inferno Bomb falls to a 70-second cooldown and arcs in from 5000 range, so he zones objectives without ever being seen. He is still the map's most immobile mage: one Satchel Charge (12s) is his whole escape plan, so flank him in fights and he dies to the same W-stun combo he died to at level 3.

notes: Chart consistent everywhere — no chart edits. Missing interaction 'Satchel bypasses stacking resistances' comes from a percentHealth flag on his W; Riot's W text has no percent-health language (it is the turret-execute passive on towers, not champions) — treated as a flag misfire per instructions and not written. Short Fuse auto-reset tell not added — no same-length slot without displacing better content; recorded here. Packet defect 'never names his abilities' now partially addressed (Satchel Charge, Q bounces, mines, Mega Inferno Bomb all named in edits).
